map.是；自然光先经起偏片变为线偏振，再对检偏片用马吕斯定律。: Yes; natural light first becomes linearly polarized through the polarizer, then Malus's law applies at the analyzer.
map.I0 是起偏前还是后？: Is I0 before or after polarization?
map.I0 指入射到检偏片的线偏振光强（通常已是起偏后的一半自然光强）。: I0 is the linearly polarized intensity incident on the analyzer (usually already half the natural light intensity after the polarizer).
